descriptionChirho: Basic Qal sense of cognitive understanding, perceiving, or comprehending a matter — Arabic fahima (فَهِمَ), Korean 깨닫다/이해하다, Swahili kuelewa.
Niphal participial/adjectival sense describing a person who possesses discernment or prudence — Arabic fahīm (فَهِيم) / faṭīn (فَطِين), Korean 총명한/분별력 있는, Swahili mwenye ufahamu/akili.
Hifil in its internal/elative sense meaning to possess or exercise understanding, be intelligent — Arabic fāhim (فَاهِم), Korean 분별하는/깨닫는 자, Swahili anayeelewa/mwenye ufahamu.
Hifil in its causative sense meaning to make someone understand, to instruct or teach — Arabic fahhama (فَهَّمَ) / mufahhim (مُفَهِّم), Korean 깨닫게 하다, Swahili -fanya aelewe/-fundisha.
Hitpael reflexive-intensive sense of careful deliberation, considering, or pondering a matter — Arabic ta'ammala (تَأَمَّلَ), Korean 생각하다/살펴보다, Swahili -zingatia/-tafakari/-fikiri.
Qal sub-sense of directing attention toward something or someone, giving regard or heed — Arabic yantabihu (يَنْتَبِهُ), Korean 돌아보다/살피다, Swahili -jali/-chunguza.
Infinitival usage expressing the abstract concept or purpose of understanding — Arabic fahm (فَهْم), Korean 깨닫기/분별하기, Swahili kuelewa.
Rare Hifil sense of acting with wisdom or prudence in conduct, overlapping with H7919a (sakal) — Arabic taṣarrafa (تَصَرَّفَ), Korean 현명하게 행하다, Swahili -tenda kwa hekima.
Piel intensive sense of attending to or caring for someone — Arabic lāḥaẓa (لَاحَظَ), Korean 살피다, Swahili -jali.
